successorSection: Section 78 (Capital gains on slump sale of undertakings)
title: Special provision for computation of capital gains in case of slump sale

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Continues under Income-tax Act, 1961 and maps to Section 78 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026.

plainTextSummary: Any profits or gains arising from the slump sale (transfer of one or more undertakings as a result of the sale for a lump sum consideration without values being assigned to individual assets and liabilities u/s 2(42C)) effected in the previous year shall be chargeable to income-tax as capital gains arising from the transfer of long-term capital assets if the undertaking was owned and held by the assessee for more than 36 months, or short-term capital assets if held for not more than 36 months. Capital gain is calculated as the Full Value of Consideration (determined under Rule 11UAE) minus the aggregate net worth of the undertaking. Revaluations are ignored; depreciable assets are valued at WDV under Section 43(6); other assets at book value. No benefit of indexation is available under Section 50B(2). Transfer of a going concern attracts 0% GST under Notification 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) Entry 2.

keyStatutoryThresholds.nonDepreciableAssetValuationBasis: Book value in balance sheet (ignoring revaluation)
keyStatutoryThresholds.mandatoryAuditReport: Form 3CEA by a practicing Chartered Accountant submitted one month prior to Section 139(1) due date
keyStatutoryThresholds.gstApplicability: Exempt (0% GST under Notification 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) Entry 2 as transfer of going concern)
keyStatutoryThresholds.successorTaxLiability: Joint and several liability under Section 313 of Income-tax Act and Section 85 of CGST Act
keyStatutoryThresholds.section281NocRequirement: Mandatory tax clearance certificate from Assessing Officer if tax assessment proceedings or demand notices are pending

officialCitations.subject: Services by way of transfer of a going concern, as a whole or an independent part thereof, attract 0% GST

requiredDocumentChecklist: Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) executing the transfer of the undertaking as a whole going concern
Form 3CEA audit certificate from an independent Chartered Accountant certifying net worth calculation
Written Down Value (WDV) tax depreciation schedule u/s 43(6) for all transferred asset blocks
Audited Balance Sheet of the undertaking immediately preceding the date of transfer
Rule 11UAE Fair Market Value (FMV1 vs FMV2) computation working papers
Section 281 Assessing Officer Tax Clearance NOC confirming no pending tax proceedings void the transfer
Form GST ITC-02 filing confirmation transferring unutilized Input Tax Credit under CGST Section 18(3)
